description: This script pretty-prints the contents of a GYP file by formatting braces and comments for better readability.

methods.name: comment_replace
methods.description: Replaces comments in a line with a placeholder for brace counting.

methods.name: mask_comments
methods.description: Masks comments in input lines to ignore braces within comments.

methods.name: quote_replace
methods.description: Replaces quoted strings with masked characters to ignore braces within quotes.

methods.name: mask_quotes
methods.description: Masks quoted strings in input lines.

methods.name: do_split
methods.description: Splits lines at brace boundaries for indentation.

methods.name: split_double_braces
methods.description: Splits lines with multiple braces for better formatting.

methods.name: count_braces
methods.description: Counts open and close braces in a line to determine indentation level.

methods.name: prettyprint_input
methods.description: Main function that indents lines based on brace counts.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that reads input and formats it.
